arxiv-2208-04049.title: Association schemes with given stratum dimensions: on a paper of Peter M. Neumann
arxiv-2208-04049.creator: Marina Anagnostopoulou-Merkouri, Peter J. Cameron
arxiv-2208-04049.description: Abstract In January 1969, Peter M. Neumann wrote a paper entitled “Primitive permutation groups of degree 3 ​ p 3p ”. The main theorem placed restrictions on the parameters of a primitive but not 2 2 -transitive permutation group of degree three times a prime.

arxiv-2301-08953.title: Second-Order Coverage Control for Multi-Agent UAV Photogrammetry
arxiv-2301-08953.creator: Samuel Mallick, Airlie Chapman, Eric Schoof
arxiv-2301-08953.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicles equipped with cameras can be used to automate image capture for generating 3D models via photogrammetry. Current methods rely on a single vehicle to capture images sequentially, or use pre-planned and heuristic imaging configurations. We seek to provide a multi-agent control approach to capturing the images required to 3D map a region.

arxiv-2304-00637.title: Automatic Design of Telecom Networks with Genetic Algorithms
arxiv-2304-00637.creator: João Correia, Gustavo Gama, João Tiago Guerrinha, Ricardo Cadime, Pedro Antero Carvalhido, Tiago Vieira, Nuno Lourenço
arxiv-2304-00637.description: Abstract With the increasing demand for high-quality internet services, deploying GPON/Fiber-to-the-Home networks is one of the biggest challenges that internet providers have to deal with due to the significant investments involved. Automated network design usage becomes more critical to aid with planning the network by minimising the costs of planning and deployment.

arxiv-2407-17196.title: Metal accretion scars may be common on magnetic, polluted white dwarfs
arxiv-2407-17196.creator: S. Bagnulo, J. D. Landstreet, J. Farihi, C. P. Folsom, M. A. Hollands, L. Fossati
arxiv-2407-17196.description: Abstract More than 30% of white dwarfs exhibit atmospheric metals, which are understood to be from recent or ongoing accretion of circumstellar debris. In cool white dwarfs, surface motions should rapidly homogenise photospheric abundances, and the accreted heavy elements should diffuse inward on a timescale much longer than that for surface mixing.

arxiv-2409-13792.title: Continual Learning for Multimodal Data Fusion of a Soft Gripper
arxiv-2409-13792.creator: Nilay Kushawaha, Egidio Falotico
arxiv-2409-13792.description: Abstract Continual learning (CL) refers to the ability of an algorithm to continuously and incrementally acquire new knowledge from its environment while retaining previously learned information. A model trained on one data modality often fails when tested with a different modality.

arxiv-2510-20238.title: COS3D: Collaborative Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
arxiv-2510-20238.creator: Runsong Zhu, Ka-Hei Hui, Zhengzhe Liu, Qianyi Wu, Weiliang Tang, Shi Qiu, Pheng-Ann Heng, Chi-Wing Fu
arxiv-2510-20238.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary 3D segmentation is a fundamental yet challenging task, requiring a mutual understanding of both segmentation and language. However, existing Gaussian-splatting-based methods rely either on a single 3D language field, leading to inferior segmentation, or on pre-computed class-agnostic segmentations, suffering from error accumulation.

britannica-1911-ghor.title: Ghor (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-ghor.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-ghor.description: Article 'Ghor' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. name of Ghor was in the middle ages, and indeed locally still is, applied to the highlands east of Herat, extending eastward to the upper Helmund valley, or nearly so. Ghor is the southern portion of that great peninsula of strong mountain country which forms the western part of modern Afghanistan.

musaeus-hero-leander-1797.title: The Loves of Hero and Leander
musaeus-hero-leander-1797.creator: Musaeus Grammaticus (trans. 1797)
musaeus-hero-leander-1797.description: The late-antique epyllion of Hero and Leander — the source for Marlowe, Chapman, Keats, and Byron.

pmc-10571879.title: First Molecular Detection of Neospora caninum in Feces of Grey Wolf (Canis lupus) and Golden Jackal (Canis aureus) Populations in Slovenia
pmc-10571879.creator: Petra Bandelj, Darja Kušar, Laura Šimenc, Urška Jamnikar-Ciglenečki, Gorazd Vengušt, Diana Žele Vengušt, Maria Luisa Menandro, Laura Tomassone
pmc-10571879.description: Simple SummaryNeospora caninum is an intracellular parasite that is the leading cause of reproductive failure in cattle worldwide and can also cause severe neuromuscular disease in dogs. The parasite circulates between herbivorous intermediate hosts (domestic and wild ruminants) and canine definitive hosts (e.g., dogs and wolves).

pmc-11294311.title: Cilostazol is a promising anti-pseudomonal virulence drug by disruption of quorum sensing
pmc-11294311.creator: Mohammed W Al-Rabia, Hani Z Asfour, Nabil A Alhakamy, Mohammed A Bazuhair, Tarek S Ibrahim, Hisham A Abbas, Basem Mansour, Wael A H Hegazy, Noura M Seleem
pmc-11294311.description: Resistance to antibiotics is a critical growing public health problem that desires urgent action to combat. To avoid the stress on bacterial growth that evokes the resistance development, anti-virulence agents can be an attractive strategy as they do not target bacterial growth.

pmc-11338466.title: Linkages between environmental sustainability, disaggregated emission, renewable energy, and energy efficiency: An evidence from BRI countries
pmc-11338466.creator: Fei Meng, Weiyan Sheng, Muhammad Waqas Akbar
pmc-11338466.description: This paper examines the long-term and short-run causative relationship among environmental sustainability, energy efficiency, renewable energy and carbon emissions from all over sources (coal, oil and fossil fuels) and sector wise division (heat and power, transportation, residential, manufacturing and other sectors.

pmc-11531478.title: Experimental evidence of phase transition of silica polymorphs in basaltic eucrites: implications for thermal history of protoplanetary crust
pmc-11531478.creator: Rei Kanemaru, Naoya Imae, Akira Yamaguchi, Aiko Nakato, Junko Isa, Makoto Kimura, Hirotsugu Nishido, Tomohiro Usui, Takashi Mikouchi
pmc-11531478.description: Silica polymorphs occur under various pressures and temperature conditions, and their characteristics can be used to better understand the complex metamorphic history of planetary materials. Here, we conducted isothermal heating experiments of silica polymorphs in basaltic eucrites to assess their formation and stability.

pmc-11601036.title: Delivering adjuvant and neoadjuvant treatments in the early stages of hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-11601036.creator: Bernardo Stefanini, Giulia F Manfredi, Antonio D’Alessio, Claudia AM Fulgenzi, Nichola Awosika, Ciro Celsa, Mario Pirisi, Cristina Rigamonti, Michela Burlone, Federica Vincenzi, Rosalba Minisini, Alessandra Gennari, Vincent Yip, Sarah Slater, Karim El-Shakankery, Ananya Jain, Francesco Tovoli, Fabio
pmc-11601036.description: IntroductionHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) presents a formidable challenge in oncology, demanding innovative treatment approaches. Both adjuvant and neoadjuvant therapies, thanks to the introduction of immunotherapy, have emerged as promising strategies in the management of HCC, aiming to reduce the risk of relapse and ultimately to improve survival.

pmc-11609142.title: Carbon Nanofiber/Polyaniline Composite Aerogel with Excellent Electromagnetic Interference Shielding, Low Thermal Conductivity, and Extremely Low Heat Release
pmc-11609142.creator: Mingyi Chen, Jian Zhu, Kai Zhang, Hongkang Zhou, Yufei Gao, Jie Fan, Rouxi Chen, Hsing-Lin Wang
pmc-11609142.description: Highlights Using electrospun high-strength carbon nanofibers as the aerogel scaffold, high loading of polyaniline in the aerogel was achieved through seed polymerization, forming the core–shell structure fibers and simultaneously connecting the fibers as a stable conductive network.Combining carbon-based materials with conductive polymers like polyaniline significantly improves shielding performance, achieving electromagnetic interference shielding efficiency of up to 84.

pmc-11612065.title: Reflection on a professional advisory group to inform the use of patient empowerment tools within an implementation science research project
pmc-11612065.creator: Katherine E Woolley, Nia J Jones, Robert Letchford, Kathleen L Withers
pmc-11612065.description: Professional advisory groups, with patient and public involvement (PPI) representatives, can be used for co-production within research projects. This paper aims to document the benefits and challenges of undertaking stakeholder and participant engagement for an implementation research project within NHS (National Health Service) Wales.

pmc-11652137.title: The relationship between carbohydrate intake and sleep patterns
pmc-11652137.creator: Yan Zhao, Hailong Guo
pmc-11652137.description: BackgroundA healthy dietary habit may contribute to good sleep quality. The present study investigates the correlation between the quality and quantity of daily carbohydrate consumption and poor sleep patterns.MethodsThe exposures of interest included low-and high-quality carbohydrate consumption and total daily carbohydrate consumption.

pmc-12821286.title: Pre-eclampsia-related TLR2/4 signaling activates NOX2/4 to induce oxidative stress and ferroptosis in trophoblasts
pmc-12821286.creator: Yan Zhang, Yunmei Ke, Baosheng Zhu, Zhuo Chen, Li Ren, Jinman Zhang, Jie Wu
pmc-12821286.description: BackgroundOxidative stress and ferroptosis have been recognized as detrimental factors in trophoblast malfunction in pre-eclampsia (PE). Here, we investigated the roles of toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling in PE-induced ferroptosis in the placenta tissues and explored the therapeutic potential of targeting TLR signaling in the animal model of PE.

pmc-13096670.title: Social influences on the occupational dietary behaviour of firefighters: A scoping review
pmc-13096670.creator: Holly Ranson, Megan Lee, Robin Orr, Louise Van Herwerden, Kristen Mackenzie‐Shalders, Amy Bannatyne
pmc-13096670.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimThis scoping review aims to explore the literature on social influences on firefighters' occupational dietary behaviour.MethodsAcademic databases (PsycINFO, Web of Science Core Collection, Scopus, PubMed, Embase, ProQuest Dissertations & Theses) were searched from inception to 29 August 2025, for published articles and theses meeting the inclusion criteria: English language, primary research studies reporting on social influences on workplace dietary behaviour in international firefighters aged 18–65 years.ResultsOf 2576 identified works, 24 met the eligibility criteria; 20 peer‐reviewed studies and four PhD dissertations.

pmc-13282233.title: Phenolic-rich extruded BRS 305 sorghum-based beverage improves fecal and blood metabolites, oxidative balance and cardiometabolic markers in adults with excess body weight: a single-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study
pmc-13282233.creator: Lucimar Aguiar da Silva, Vinícius Parzanini Brilhante de São José, Álvaro Luiz Miranda Piermatei, Larissa Arruda Rodrigues, Pietra Vidal Cardoso do Prado, Renata Celi Lopes Toledo, Carlos Wanderlei Piler de Carvalho, Valéria Aparecida Vieira Queiroz, Bárbara Pereira da Silva, Joseph Francis Pierre, Hércia Stampini Duarte Martino

pmc-13347211.title: Exploring novel indenoquinoxaline Schiff bases as corrosion inhibitors for conversion coating on mild steel: ultrasonication-assisted synthesis and electrochemical and computational studies
pmc-13347211.creator: Hamdy Khamees Thabet, Moustafa S. Abusaif, Ghalia A. Gaber, Ahmed Ragab, Yousry A. Ammar, Amira M. Hyba
pmc-13347211.description: Three new organic inhibitors, IQ-SSC, IQ-BSC, and IQ-HSC, based on indenoquinoxaline Schiff bases, were synthesized via a rapid, highly efficient, and ultrasonication-assisted protocol, with excellent yields of 99%. The electrochemical behavior and weight-loss measurements of bare mild steel and coated mild steel with organic inhibitors were evaluated in both 0.5 M H2SO4 and 3.5% NaCl solutions.

pmc-13379382.title: Effects of methylphenidate on the human vascular endothelium
pmc-13379382.creator: Wenjie Cai, MaiBritt Giacobini, Cecilia Österholm, Catharina Lavebratt
pmc-13379382.description: Methylphenidate (MPH) is a widely used psychostimulant for treating attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Emerging epidemiological findings suggest that MPH treatment increases the risk of cardiovascular events. However, as causality could not be inferred, further investigation of the potential impact of MPH on human vascular endothelial function is warranted.

pmc-13457383.title: Recent advances in poly(butylene adipate-co-terephthalate) (PBAT): structure, modification strategies, degradation, and sustainable applications
pmc-13457383.creator: Xinyue Wang, Jintang Guo

pmc-13628798.title: Plant-based milk powders: technological challenges, nutritional opportunities, and market outlook
pmc-13628798.creator: Ismail Tontul, Sultan Arslan Tontul
pmc-13628798.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The global demand for plant-based milk has increased in response to health, sustainability, and dietary concerns. Liquid products are not without their advantages, but powdered forms offer unique benefits, including shelf stability, lightweight distribution, and versatile food applications. Despite the growth in market value, there is a paucity of systematic research addressing the processing of plant-based milk powders, particularly the influence of drying technologies and formulation strategies on yield, nutrient retention, and functionality.
